name: com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp.splines
description: MCP Tools for Unity Splines - Author and edit Splines with AI through the MCP framework. Create SplineContainers, add/insert/remove knots, set knot position/tangents/rotation and tangent modes, toggle closed loops, evaluate points/tangents along a spline, and read or modify any spline component via natural language.
